Waiting for other members on the LAN to join…
On the same WiFi, each device broadcasts its own view (front/back camera or screen) and simultaneously receives every member\'s video — no internet, no central server
· Fallback: each fragment also unicast per member; CSD replay every 2 s, missing frames trigger keyframe requests
· Discovery: UDP 9998 directed broadcast/multicast, 6 s timeout
· Limit: UDP does not guarantee delivery; packet loss causes smearing/black screens; keyframe re-requests are only a fallback and cannot keep weak links smooth
· Limit: with AP client isolation enabled, broadcast/multicast/unicast cannot pass — there is no application-layer workaround
· Limit: screen sharing needs system consent every time; on Android 14+ one consent session allows only one virtual display — after stopping, consent is required again
